method: built-in image_gen; deterministic offline atlas preparation
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game-ready planetary ground albedo atlas for Void Drift. Reference image is a concept portrait, not an edit target. Create its matching FLAT FULL 360 DEGREE EQUIRECTANGULAR longitude-latitude SURFACE MAP, exact 2:1 landscape rectangle filled edge to edge with surface. Preserve its distinctive terrain, colours, water/ice and sci-fi idea, invent a coherent hidden hemisphere. Longitude left-right, north pole top, south pole bottom. Seamless periodic horizontal wrap with matching left/right edges; polar regions stretched horizontally for correct spherical mapping, no pinched vertical perspective. The atlas must be evenly lit diffuse albedo, consistent surface brightness across entire map. Remove ALL globe lighting, specular highlights, terminator, spherical silhouette, shadows, atmosphere, clouds, glow, background space, borders and text. Water is matte even blue/teal albedo, not white specular. Restrained painted mineral detail matching the portrait and existing Mercury/Cradle material. Keep broad coherent shapes and selective mid-scale texture; texture covers all pixels with no gaps. Not a rendered globe, not a perspective view, not a collage. Subject: A temperate alien biosphere world: dark slate-blue oceans, broad continents bearing subdued smoky plum and muted aubergine vegetation, dusty mauve uplands, pale grey mountain chains and modest white polar ice. Science-fiction idea: enormous organic branching colonies form broad vein-like patterns across one continent and into coastal shallows, subtly biological rather than luminous. The vegetation must read as surface material, not purple clouds. Natural geography, restrained palette with convincing material complexity.
preparation: Native image resampling; 24px symmetric longitude edge blend; 6px polar cap blend; clouds use the Cradle density-to-alpha smoothstep (0.1–0.5).
